answer: In an agent marketplace trading river forecasts, whisper recordings, and yarrow seeds, each seller identity must lock a $100 bond for 30 days before accepting orders. The bond is forfeited when a signed delivery receipt proves a missed deadline. Creating names is cheap, but activating 1,000 sellers ties up $100,000; splitting into fake identities cannot evade the per-seller capital requirement or the loss on each proven default.
